title: fix(sessions): compute devin CLI context % for archived sessions too
context:
The first pass gated context-% computation to the live session only,
because a naive batched query (ROW_NUMBER window function over the whole
message_nodes table) forced SQLite to read every session's full turn
history to determine the last row per session, and Devin CLI's sessions.db
stores full turn content inline (observed: multi-GB across a few thousand
rows) -- that version hung for 10+ minutes on a real corpus.

Replaced it with one query per session ("ORDER BY node_id DESC LIMIT 8"),
whic
consequences: Removes _devin_cli_list_context_usage — potential breaking change for callers.
